findings.title: Unbounded shared CSV provenance multiplies row allocations and snapshot size
findings.location: registry_authoring.go:187-189 and CSV note/discovered_by construction at363-372
findings.trigger: CSV import sets a very large discovered_by label, copied into note and discovered_by for every row before shared merge.

actual_witness.projection: 128*2*65536 = 16777216 provenance-value bytes, before JSON overhead. Allowed maximum65536 rows*2*(64MiB provenance) = 8TiB provenance-value bytes, while recipe remains below128MiB.

findings.impact: A tiny batch plus bounded profile can request multi-terabyte derived values. This is a local resource-exhaustion risk beyond the stated input limits, not a claim that all hostile-input allocation must be sandboxed.
findings.recommendation: Bound the CSV shared provenance label in the existing policy guard. A1..512 UTF-8 byte bound preserves the actual282-byte source identity;256 would reject it. No new parser/helper/config needed.
findings.status: Open in reviewed immutable55. Parent owns any fix and fresh delta QA.

FieldPos/InputOffset spans only restore CRLF normalized by the standard parser and verify equality after that normalization; quote/comma/Unicode/newline cases are independently frozen. Strict headers/width and malformed-record refusals are deliberate stronger boundaries.

review_assessment.limits: 64 batches,65536 total rows,64MiB aggregate batch bytes and64MiB glyphmap bytes are present. These are intake bounds; RRI-1 identifies the independent duplicated-label dimension.
review_assessment.glyph_root: The explicit object-root check precedes glyphMaps, preventing null/array roots from space-only text bypasses. Empty object is structurally valid with an empty repertoire.
review_assessment.quality: Cohesive extension of authorRegistry and shared guards/publisher,0 new functions and one public plus one local type. CSV span bookkeeping is substantial but protects exact source values and is not a parallel grammar parser. No additional concrete correctness defect found in this bounded review.
